caption: An empty entry becomes an error message. The parser pops the nonterminal only when the lookahead is in its FOLLOW set; otherwise it drops the lookahead and checks the next token.

spec.title: Panic-mode recovery
spec.aria: An empty table entry triggers an error report; the parser pops the nonterminal if the lookahead is in its FOLLOW set, otherwise it skips tokens and checks again.
